title: Classical baselines vs QAOA
description: Mean over 5 fixed-seed 10-asset, K=5, q=0.5 instances (no sector cap or target, zero costs), est window 2023-10-01..2025-09-30. Same problems and rules for every method; QAOA uses the XY mixer, p = 3, COBYLA, ramp init.
x_label: Method (0 = Brute force (exact), 1 = Relaxation + rounding, 2 = Simulated annealing, 3 = QAOA (XY mixer))

series.label: Found the exact optimum (share of instances)

notes: Each method reports one portfolio; QAOA reports its best feasible sample (never repaired).
Mean runtime per instance: Brute force (exact) 0.005 s, Relaxation + rounding 0.021 s, Simulated annealing 0.172 s, QAOA (XY mixer) 4.639 s.
Synthetic subset of NIFTY 50 tickers; estimation window 2023-10-01..2025-09-30
5 instance(s) with seeds [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], QAOA seed = instance seed, maxiter 60, 4096 shots; yerr is the sample standard deviation over instances.
